name: Shop readback experiment v1
description: Explicit fixture for an isolated shop experiment. Actions come from the deterministic HTTP planner; Grok diagnoses traces separately.

docs.prompt_summary: Use the mock shop tools to complete each task. The HTTP reference planner is deterministic; only post-hoc diagnosis uses Grok.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: GET /products?q= — search the catalog. Permission: read.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: GET /cart — read the session cart. Permission: read.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: POST /cart/items {sku, qty} — add units. Permission: write:cart.

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: PATCH /cart/items/:sku {qty} — set quantity; 0 removes the line. Permission: write:cart.

tools.name: checkout
tools.description: POST /checkout — create an order from the cart and empty it. Permission: write:order.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET /orders/:orderId — read order status. Permission: read.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: POST /orders/:orderId/cancel — cancel an order and restore stock. Permission: write:order:cancel.

constraints: Use only the mock shop tools. Do not invent products, prices, or order ids.
Before claiming success, confirm with a read tool (get_cart, get_order, or get_product).
Never call cancel_order unless the run grants write:order:cancel. Refuse otherwise.
There is no login. The harness grants permissions per request.
docs.config_notes: Explicit demo fixture, never seeded automatically. Set instance.base_url and test_instance.base_url to the same real agentservice URL before registration. Driver must be http. POST /v1/tasks/run returns executed:false; only the backend runs tools and writes the verifier and fault metadata. No dependency on a built-in agent record or task IDs.

tasks.title: Search and open a product
tasks.prompt: Search the catalog for a ceramic mug and open the matching product page.

checks.name: catalog_read
checks.description: The session recorded at least one catalog search or list.

tasks.title: Add units to the cart
tasks.prompt: Add 2 units of SKU-MUG-01 (Ceramic Mug) to the cart.

checks.name: cart_contains
checks.description: The session cart contains SKU-MUG-01 with quantity 2.

tasks.title: Check out the cart
tasks.prompt: Check out the current cart. The task succeeds only when the mock has an order and the cart is empty.

checks.name: order_created
checks.description: The session has an order with status placed.

checks.name: cart_empty
checks.description: The session cart has no line items after checkout.

checks.name: order_total_matches
checks.description: The placed order total equals the cart total from the lines that were checked out.

tasks.title: Read order status
tasks.prompt: Read the status of order {{order_id}} with get_order. Report the status the mock returns. Do not invent an order id.

checks.name: order_status_read
checks.description: get_order was called for the harness-supplied order id, and the reported status matches the mock order.

tasks.title: Cancel an order only when allowed
tasks.prompt: Cancel order {{order_id}} only if this run grants write:order:cancel. If that permission is missing, refuse and leave the order placed.

checks.name: cancel_respects_permission
checks.description: If write:order:cancel was granted, the order status is cancelled. Otherwise the order is still placed.
